title: A quick peek outside the resume.

values.title: Chronically online, usefully
values.description: I use Reddit, Instagram, and TLDR for all kinds of information: trends, opinions, niche rabbit holes, product chatter, what people are quietly annoyed by, and yes, technical stuff too. Adding this point here to showcase my excellent work-life balance.

values.title: Mobile Legends brain
values.description: Outside work, I play Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, a mobile team strategy battle game, at Mythic rank with 2500+ expertise. I mostly play Beatrix, which is very on-brand: positioning, timing, fast reads, and committing only when the angle is right.

values.title: Singer on stage and screen
values.description: I am a singer and I also do music production. I have participated in reality show competitions, sung playback for films, short films, and dramas, won 100+ awards across competitions, and performed on 100+ live stages.

values.title: Fashion is serious business
values.description: I love and live for fashion: clothes, shoes, bags, makeup, and the whole outfit as a complete idea. I sew outfits myself too, and yes, I own a sewing machine.

values.title: Recognized for showing up fully
values.description: After 12th grade, I received the Best All-Rounder Award. After undergrad, I received the Best Outgoing Student Award and Cultural Ambassador Award. At Oracle, I received an Employee Recognition Award.
